meta.name: trace-claude-code
meta.description:
Automatically trace Claude Code conversations to Braintrust for observability.
Captures sessions, conversation turns, and tool calls as hierarchical traces.

copy.tagline: 自动追踪 Claude Code 对话并记录到 Braintrust
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Claude Code 并需要记录对话用于调试或分析
copy.tagline_en: Automatically trace Claude Code conversations to Braintrust
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Claude Code and need to log conversations for debugging or analysis

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude Code 的每次对话和工具调用都会被自动记录到 Braintrust，形成层级分明的追踪记录，方便你查看 AI 编程会话的完整过程。
howto.when: 当你启动 Claude Code 并执行操作（如读取文件、编辑代码、运行命令）时，该技能会自动捕获每个会话、对话轮次和工具调用。

say.text: 帮我给这个函数添加错误处理。
运行测试并告诉我结果。
say.note: 终端命令和 Claude 的响应都会被追踪。
Git 命令和提交信息都会被记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, every Claude Code conversation and tool call is automatically logged to Braintrust as hierarchical traces, giving you full visibility into your AI coding sessions.
howto.when_en: When you start Claude Code and perform actions (e.g., reading files, editing code, running commands), the skill automatically captures each session, conversation turn, and tool call.

say_en.text: Add error handling to this function.
say_en.note: Claude will read and edit files; these operations are traced.

say_en.text: Run the tests and show me the results.
say_en.note: Terminal commands and Claude's response are captured.
Git commands and commit messages are recorded.
